integrity: All-n proof by a bijection to two boundary walks; finite exhaustive checks n<=7 are corroborative, not substitutes for proof. Established older rank formulas credited. First mismatch with published Conjecture 14 occurs at n=7.
limitations: Only finite full contractions of integer chains; not partial contractions, weighted metrics, arbitrary graph maps, or any assertion of absolute bibliographic novelty.
title: Complete image-rank enumeration of nonexpansive retractions of finite chains
